title: Desktop, taskbar & Finder
blurb: Icons, taskbar, Dock, notifications, screenshots, windows.

remedies.title: Icons are blank, wrong or thumbnails don't show
remedies.why: The icon and thumbnail cache is out of date or damaged.

steps.text: Rebuild the icon and thumbnail cache (Explorer restarts).
Turn thumbnails back on: Folder options › View › untick "Always show icons, never thumbnails".
Restart the Mac; for one app's wrong icon, reinstall the app.

remedies.title: Taskbar disappeared or moved
remedies.why: Auto-hide is on, the taskbar is on another monitor, or Explorer needs a restart.

steps.text: Turn off auto-hide: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar behaviours.
Check your other monitor; the taskbar may show there.
Restart Explorer.

remedies.title: Dock disappeared, moved, or icons are missing
remedies.why: The Dock hides automatically, moved to another screen, or needs a restart.

steps.text: Move the pointer to the bottom (or side) of the screen; turn off "Automatically hide and show the Dock".
With two screens, move the pointer to the bottom of the other screen and keep it there to bring the Dock over.
Drag apps from Applications back into the Dock to pin them.

remedies.title: Not getting notifications
remedies.why: Do not disturb / Focus is on, the app's notifications are off, or it only shows in the notification centre.

steps.text: Turn off Do not disturb, check the app is on and its banners are allowed.
Turn off Focus, and check the app's style is Banners or Alerts.
Check the app's own notification settings too.

remedies.title: Take a screenshot
remedies.why: Both systems have built-in screenshot shortcuts.

steps.text: Windows+Shift+S picks an area (copied, and saved by the Snipping Tool). Print Screen does the same on Windows 11.
⌘+Shift+4 picks an area, ⌘+Shift+3 the whole screen, ⌘+Shift+5 shows all options and recording.
DeskShot (a sister DeskLab app) adds markup, blur and pinning.

remedies.title: Put two windows side by side
remedies.why: Both systems can tile windows to halves or quarters of the screen.

steps.text: Windows+Left/Right arrow, or hover the Maximise button for Snap layouts.
Hover the green button › Move & Resize › Left or Right; or Window › Move & Resize. Fn+Ctrl+arrows tile on recent macOS.

remedies.title: Copy and paste stopped working
remedies.why: The clipboard service got stuck, often because of a remote-desktop app or a clipboard tool.

steps.text: Try another app to see if it's one app only.
Close remote-desktop windows and clipboard managers.
Restart Explorer.
Clipboard history (Windows+V) can be turned off and on in Settings › System › Clipboard.
In Activity Monitor, quit the process "pboard" (it restarts by itself).

remedies.title: Files disappeared from my desktop
remedies.why: Desktop icons are hidden, files moved into OneDrive/iCloud (Desktop backup), or you're signed in with a temporary profile.

steps.text: Right-click the desktop › View › Show desktop icons.
Look in OneDrive › Desktop: OneDrive backup moves the Desktop folder into OneDrive.
"You've been signed in with a temporary profile": restart; if it stays, tell IT (your files are still there).
Desktop & Documents in iCloud Drive keeps them under iCloud Drive › Desktop; also check Stage Manager or "Show items" settings.

remedies.title: Start menu shows web results, ads or news
remedies.why: Windows mixes Bing results, widgets and recommendations into Start and the taskbar.

steps.text: Turn off Widgets and Task view in Taskbar settings.
Turn off recommendations and tips in Start settings.
Turn off "Show search highlights" in Privacy & security › Search permissions.
